newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Turkish mission to probe border attack.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Turkish mission to probe border attack.

text.p: A delegation from Turkey is expected in Iran soon for a final investigation into an alleged Turkish helicopter attack on an Iranian border region in June, the official Iranian News Agency IRNA said on Sunday.
Iran has said a Turkish raid on Kurdish rebels killed six Iranian civilians and wounded 19 others. Turkey denies any incursion into Iran.

The director general for security affairs at Iran's interior ministry, Amir Hussein Motahar, was quoted by IRNA as saying the decision to conduct the probe was made at a Turkish-Iranian security committee meeting in Ankara.
Motahar did not specify when the delegation would arrive.
"(Motahar) said that all documents concerning the attack have been submitted to the Turkish Interior Minister, Mehmet Agar, and he has promised to open an inquiry into the case," IRNA said.
Agar would travel to Iran after the fact-finding mission returns, IRNA quoted Motahar as saying.
The alleged June attack further strained ties between Tehran and Ankara, already tense over Iranian objections to a Turkish military accord with Israel.
